attempts.text:
The Trishuli farm and Bidur farm cluster has no open road to either evacuation point (its only link to Suryagadhi temple is damaged), so those 3 adults must be deferred. Everyone else is reachable. Car1 handles Dhunche, Galchhi, Suryagadhi and Kalika. Car2 handles Shivapuri and Gosaikunda. Driving totals 180 minutes and deferrals 60, for a total cost of 240.
